notes: Portable translation of the verified 34-assertion native untimed save active-callback resignation witness. In HLA_EVOKED, three federates join an adapter-supplied FOM; the scenario uses the untimed Create Federation Execution overload and does not require a logical-time implementation. The held and departing members begin the save inside Initiate Federate Save callbacks. Resignation within the departing callback is rejected by the standard CallNotAllowedFromWithinCallback exception; the same resignation after callback return succeeds. Surviving members receive Federation Not Saved with FEDERATE_RESIGNED_DURING_SAVE, the departed member receives no stale failure, and a subsequent two-member save completes. Direct native traceability pairs are page-058-l112-33 to IEEE 1516.1-2025 clause 4.12, page-065-l96-24 to clause 4.19, page-066-l22-5 to clause 4.19.6, page-067-l142-36 to clause 4.21.1, and page-069-l70-17, page-069-l76-19, and page-069-l133-38 to clause 4.23. Official-header C++ primary and contract passed twice against installed package libraries in an isolated build; a focused rerun without a time implementation passed 2/2. The Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR but has no provider-runtime result. This is an evoked-callback slice, not an immediate-callback or provider-independent conformance claim.
